title: Abakoresha
intro: Konti zose ziri kuri uru rubuga. Tumira abantu, uvugurure amakuru yabo kandi ubuze kwinjira igihe bibaye ngombwa.

invite.title: Tumira umukoresha
invite.studioHint: Si ngombwa. Hitamo sitidiyo kugira ngo ahite ahabwa uruhare muri yo.
invite.hint: Amazina arakenewe kuri konti nshya. Niba imeri isanzwe ifite konti, yongerwa gusa muri sitidiyo.
invite.addedExisting: {{email}} asanzwe afite konti kandi yongewe muri sitidiyo

disable.title: Uhagarika {{name}}?
disable.body: Asohorwa ahantu hose kandi ntashobora kwinjira kugeza konti yongeye gukoreshwa. Inshingano afite muri sitidiyo ziragumaho.

enable.title: Wongera gukoresha konti ya {{name}}?
enable.body: Azongera kwinjira akoresheje ijambobanga n’inshingano yari asanganywe.

signOut.title: Usohora {{name}} ahantu hose?
signOut.body: Buri gikoresho kizasabwa kongera kwinjira. Paji zifunguye zishobora gukomeza gukora iminota igera kuri 30.

link.emailed: Link twayohereje kuri {{email}}. Ushobora no kuyimwoherereza ubwawe.
link.notEmailed: Imeri ntiratunganywa kuri seriveri, bityo oherereza {{email}} iyi link ubwawe (urugero kuri WhatsApp).
link.label: Link ikoreshwa rimwe
link.inviteHint: Ikora rimwe gusa kandi irangira mu minsi 7. Uyifite wese ashobora gushyiraho ijambobanga, bityo yohereze uyu muntu wenyine.
link.resetHint: Ikora rimwe gusa kandi irangira mu isaha 1. Uyifite wese ashobora gushyiraho ijambobanga, bityo yohereze uyu muntu wenyine.
